description:
Lex Luthor falls ill and finds out that the glowing green space rock from outer space famous for it's radiation is actually not healthy for him to have on him 24/7. Kryptonite poisioning, who would've guessed. If not obvious the last two episodes came from a re-watch of the series and this one really just baffled me. Love this show. Superman be cray cray!
